b_16_00.scope: Identical frozen QSO members: remove each actual NSC band or calendar year without reassociation. QSO diagnostics only; no zero/error coefficients trained. Conditional fit residual medians are not unbiased held positions. Time/band deletions are coupled by real sampling; insufficient-time cases kept in counts.

b_16_00.scope: Only half the original C0-held physical galaxies train; disjoint half validates. At least 50 training references, 20 within-night and 20 between-night pairs and four nights required. QSO never train parameters. Same fixed B detections in every fit.
b_16_00.limitations: Conditional mixture-likelihood decomposition of published marginal errors; parameter-learning uncertainty and cross-axis night covariance not propagated. Cross-band nightly correlation is unknown: independent-band and fully shared-instrument night terms bracket assumptions, not validated final models. Source/physical-night validation and independent-year testing required.
